text.title: Portfolio Evm Rollup Method — Decision Tree

decision-tree.root-question: Does the portfolio have at least 3 projects, each with a week-grain PV / EV / AC ledger, a named portfolio owner and a scheduled executive review?

branch.when: project_count < 3 OR all_projects_evm == false OR owner_named == false OR exec_review_scheduled == false
branch.conclusion: Skip. Below 3 projects single-project EVM is enough; without per-project ledgers there is nothing to aggregate; an OKR-only org needs a different shape.

branch.when: project_count >= 3 AND all_projects_evm == true AND owner_named == true AND exec_review_scheduled == true
branch.question: Do all ledger exports share the data date, with any project older than one period flagged `stale` and excluded?

branch.conclusion: Block. Align exports to one data date; flag and exclude stale projects; never carry values forward.

branch.question: Are portfolio SPI and CPI computed as sum(EV) / sum(PV) and sum(EV) / sum(AC) in one currency, with the EV method named per project and LOE shown separately?

branch.conclusion: Recompute from currency sums; record the EV method per project; separate LOE from discrete work.

branch.question: Does every project beyond the stated variance thresholds carry a narrative, and does the summary state EAC vs BAC and fixed-bid margin in currency over a three-period trend?

branch.conclusion: State the thresholds; add a cause + corrective-action line for each project beyond them.
Add portfolio EAC vs BAC, VAC and per-project fixed-bid margin in currency.

branch.when: thresholds_stated == true AND narrative_missing_beyond_threshold == 0 AND money_block_missing == false
branch.conclusion: Run the rollup: per-project table, currency-sum aggregate, three-period trend, variance narrative, money block; portfolio owner signs before the review.
